text: A股主要指数半日收盘普涨，其中，沪指涨0.08%报3826.51点，深证成指涨0.41%报12911.78点，创业板指涨0.34%，科创50涨0.58%，微盘股涨2.16%。 量能大幅萎缩，沪深两市半日成交额8762亿，较上个交易日缩量2848亿。全市场超4000只个股上涨。盘面上，热点快速轮动，固态电池概念爆发，武汉蓝电30CM涨停，尚水智能20CM涨停，上海洗霸、国轩高科、金龙羽涨停；PCB依顿电子、奥士康、超声电子、迅捷兴涨停；房地产深物业A二连板，滨江集团、信达地产、华联控股涨停，万科A盘中触及涨停；电力浙江新能2连板，宁波能源涨停。下跌方面，玻
text_en: Major A-share indices closed broadly higher in the half-day session, with the Shanghai Composite Index up 0.08% at 3,826.51 points, the Shenzhen Component Index up 0.41% at 12,911.78 points, the ChiNext Index up 0.34%, STAR 50 up 0.58%, and micro-cap stocks up 2.16%. Volume shrank sharply, with half-day turnover in the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets at 876.2 billion yuan, down 284.8 billion yuan from the previous trading day. More than 4,000 stocks in the whole market rose. On the board, hot spots rotated rapidly, the solid-state battery concept exploded, Wuhan Landian hit the 30CM daily limit, Shangshui Intelligent hit the 20CM daily limit, and Shanghai Xiba, Gotion High-Tech and Jinlongyu hit the daily limit; PCB names Yidun Electronics, Aoshikang, Chaozhou Three-Circle and Xunjiexing hit the daily limit; real estate name Shenzhen Property A notched a second consecutive daily limit, Binjiang Group, Xinda Real Estate and Hualian Holdings hit the daily limit, and China Vanke A touched the daily limit intraday; power name Zhejiang Xinneng notched a second consecutive daily limit and Ningbo Energy hit the daily limit.
